_doc: FluentBooking vendor-map per PRINCIPLES-VENDOR.md V11. One row per touched ability. Populated incrementally as fix packages land.

abilities.notes: Package 2 V10 fix (F-BOOK-01). Vendor AvailabilityService::getDefaultSchedule() can call reset() on a null schedule list when the calendar user has no configured availability, raising a PHP TypeError that previously bubbled as a fatal. Registrar now wraps the getDefaultSchedule call in try/catch and returns WP_Error('vendor_precondition_failed', …). CalendarSlot::create remains the canonical write path.

Package 2 V10 signature-alignment fix (F-BOOK-02). Vendor TimeSlotService constructor is __construct(Calendar $calendar, CalendarSlot $calendarSlot) per installed source app/Services/TimeSlotService.php:18 — the prior registrar passed (CalendarSlot, string $timezone) which produced a PHP TypeError on every call. Registrar now looks up the parent Calendar via CalendarSlot::calendar_id and passes both objects to the constructor; the slot lookup uses the public getDates($fromDate, $toDate, $duration, $isDoingBooking, $timeZone) method (the prior call to a non-existent getAvailableSlots($start, $end) is replaced).
